methodology_disclosure.look_ahead_bias_prevention: Signals at day t strictly consume candles[:t+1]; fills occur on bar t+1 open (or t+1..t+3 low for pullbacks). Conservative intrabar SL-before-TP ordering.
methodology_disclosure.survivorship_bias_control: Evaluates full configured universe (12 assets) including weak/breakdown names (e.g., ZEEL, TATAMOTORS).
methodology_disclosure.transaction_costs: Entry slippage 5.0 bps + Exit slippage 5.0 bps + Statutory/Brokerage 25.0 bps (0.35% total friction per closed trade).
methodology_disclosure.separation_guarantee: Walk-forward backtest returns are labeled strictly as historical simulations and isolated from actual Zerodha Kite executed trades.
